judgements.justification: B's CnYk said the rebuttal 'answered my major concern' on the parser misreading, then kept 4 citing closed GPT-3 and novelty.
Both committees got the same promises (citations, rewording); B rejected on the conceded hand-built world model, not on refusing to credit promised fixes.
No reviewer in either committee stated a changed stance without editing the score; B's reviewers said they kept their ratings.
No late or off-record extra reviewer appears in either committee, and neither panel was split.
Clarity was not in dispute; A praised the writing and B's objections were to the world model, novelty and framing.
The only score that rose, oMsG's in A, came with a stated reason (the clarifications) and the review text no longer argued against acceptance.
Neither chair discounted a silent reviewer; B counted Ms3t's unengaged 3 and A counted wEz8's unengaged 9, both on unanimous panels.
A's only high rating, wEz8's 9, rests on a thin summary review with no checked reading and no advocacy in discussion (R03, R12).
No reviewer in either committee admitted reading only part of the paper.
Both committees questioned the System 1/System 2 framing as a stretch; no committee read the paper from a different theoretical tradition.
A's four-sentence meta-review argues only that all reviewers agree to publish and gives no reason for a spotlight over a poster.
Prior-literature knowledge was spread across both committees (oMsG in A, CnYk in B), and B's Ms3t wrongly claimed no baselines rather than checking them.
B's meta-review states the reviewers' unanimous rejection accurately; it omits that two objections were wrong, but does not misstate positions.
No reviewer or chair in either committee raised narrow audience or venue fit.
The misreading detractors (Ms3t, CnYk) sat in B, the reject committee, not in a committee arguing acceptance against them.
The only new result (5 versus 10 samples, for Tn5q in A) moved no score; oMsG rose on explanation and promises alone.
B's reviewers all rated at confidence 4 with no standout expert, and A's top-confidence reviews were at or above the others.
CnYk's new grounds came during the discussion and changed no score; no score changed on an objection the authors could not answer.
A's verbal assessments were more favourable (proof of concept accepted) than B's (world model fatal), so the rating gap reflects different judgements, R08 and R18.
Overstated framing or title was raised in both committees (Eow4 and oMsG in A, Ms3t and the meta-review in B), not by one only.
A's reviewers did not converge on marginal-accept at low confidence; ratings 6, 9, 6, 7 at confidence 4 to 5.
